description: This file is a shell script used for testing the behavior of the 'git hash-object' command in various scenarios related to buffers without NUL termination. It defines functions for resetting test state, adding test content, and checking the correctness of object parsing, specifically focusing on edge cases like truncated inputs and malformed objects. The script runs a series of tests to ensure the robustness of object parsing in the Git implementation, particularly for buffer overrun prevention.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the test environment by creating an empty base file.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a content line with a type prefix to the base file for testing.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Performs a test to verify that truncated or malformed objects cause 'git hash-object' to fail as expected and produce the correct error message.
